changelog_text:
## Changes
- First release. Payload fairings from the fictional rocket maker Purrline Rocketworks, sized for the stock 2 m and 3 m tanks.
- Fairing halves of 2 m (4.55, 6.10 and 7.65 m long) and 3 m (7.60, 9.15 and 12.25 m long). Place two halves on a base.
- Fairing Base 2 m and Fairing Base 3 m, each with a payload adapter on the inner connector.
- Hammerhead bases: Fairing Base 2 m to 3 m puts a 3 m fairing on a 2 m stage, Fairing Base 3 m to 4 m puts a 4 m fairing (3 m halves at scale 1.33) on a 3 m stage.
- Every half and both hammerhead bases come in white paint or black carbon. Press V on a placed part to change the look.
- Inside each half is a quilted acoustic blanket that you see when the halves fall away.
- The halves clear the payload from scale 0.5 to 2.0, also while the stage accelerates at up to 2 g. With the scale tool, the 2 m set makes a 1 m fairing.
- The Fairing Half 2 m Medium and the Fairing Base 2 m were the fairing of Prisma by Purrline Rocketworks 1.0.0. They keep their part Ids, so saved Prisma vehicles load with their fairing.
- Prisma 1.1.0 contains the same 2 m fairing. You can install Prisma 1.1.0 and Fairings together, in any mod order.

## Compatibility
Validated against KSA build version **2026.11.10.5801**.
**Prisma 1.0.0 contains the same two fairing parts. Update Prisma to 1.1.0 before you enable this mod**, or the fairing does not load. Borea does not let Prisma 1.0.0 and this mod into one instance.

## Installation
Extract into `Documents\My Games\Kitten Space Agency\mods\PurrlineFairings\`.
No mod loader needed.

listing.description:
![The fairing family in orbit](ksa-image:family)

**Fairings** is a set of payload fairings for Kitten Space Agency, from the fictional rocket maker **Purrline Rocketworks**. The sizes fit the stock 2 m and 3 m tanks, and the hammerhead bases put a wider fairing on a narrower stage.

## Parts

- **Fairing Half 2 m Short**, **Medium** and **Long**: fairing halves of 4.55, 6.10 and 7.65 m; place two.
- **Fairing Half 3 m Short**, **Medium** and **Long**: fairing halves of 7.60, 9.15 and 12.25 m.
- **Fairing Base 2 m** and **Fairing Base 3 m**: base rings with a payload adapter.
- **Fairing Base 2 m to 3 m** and **Fairing Base 3 m to 4 m**: hammerhead bases; a 3 m half at scale 1.33 makes the 4 m fairing.

Every half and both hammerhead bases come in white paint or black carbon (press V on a placed part). Inside each half is a quilted acoustic blanket that you see when the halves fall away. With the scale tool of the editor the 2 m set also makes a 1 m fairing.

![All parts and both looks](ksa-image:all-parts)

![The acoustic blanket inside the halves](ksa-image:interior)

![The hammerhead bases](ksa-image:hammerheads)

## Prisma

The 2 m medium half and the 2 m base were the fairing of Prisma by Purrline Rocketworks 1.0.0 and keep their part Ids, so saved Prisma vehicles load with their fairing. Prisma 1.1.0 and later contain the same 2 m fairing, so you can install Prisma and Fairings together, in any mod order. Update Prisma to 1.1.0 or later before you enable Fairings: Prisma 1.0.0 contains the same fairing parts in an older form, and with both enabled the fairing does not load.

## Install

- Borea: install Fairings from the content list.
- By hand: copy `PurrlineFairings` from the release zip into `Documents/My Games/Kitten Space Agency/mods/` and enable it.

To remove the mod, delete its folder. Vehicles with its parts do not load without it.

Made for KSA build 2026.11.10.5801.
